title: Command execution with Runtime.exec
description: Runs a system process. If the command includes external data, there is a command-injection risk.
remediation: Avoid it; if needed, use a fixed argument array and validate any external data.
falsePositives: Fixed commands (for example reading properties or root detection).

title: ProcessBuilder creation
description: Prepares the execution of a system process.
remediation: Check where the arguments come from.

title: Dynamic code loading (DexClassLoader)
description: Loads code from outside the verified APK. If the file can be replaced (external storage, unverified download), arbitrary code runs.
remediation: Avoid it; if needed, load only from read-only internal storage and verify integrity.
falsePositives: Multidex libraries, legitimate plugins and third-party SDKs.

title: Reflection (Class.forName / Method.invoke)
description: Calls resolved at run time hide the real flow from static code.
remediation: Review manually which classes and methods are reached.
